origin.summary: Create a dedicated Meshingress library module responsible for installing and verifying tool dependencies, beginning with Python GitHub repositories and undeclared Python dependency detection.

events.note: Activated for the x-faster-whisper local virtual-environment provisioning and Java-to-Python MCP bridge slice.
Added the provider-neutral provisioning contract, local Python venv provider, x-faster-whisper bridge, local venv, and focused verification.

Absorbed the unfinished managed source-resolution and activation work from the resolved tool-manifest external-requirements record; the manifest declaration surface remains complete, while its provisioning lifecycle is active here.

Recorded manifest, repository, runtime-loader, artifact-storage, process-runner, and toolspace reuse boundaries before implementation to avoid duplicate source acquisition or activation lifecycle code.
Added managed Git checkout staging, canonical vendor placement, commit markers, pinned-revision reuse, revision invalidation, optional subdirectory support, and local Git fixture tests.
Connected trusted cached static manifests to pinned Git source provisioning before classloading and registry registration; server startup and read-only MCP listing passed.
Excluded local vendor source and virtual-environment paths at both resource-copy and JAR assembly stages; focused tests and incremental artifact inspection passed.
Declared and registered the pinned Faster Whisper Git source plus tool-local runtime and STT configuration metadata through the auto-configuration manifest pattern.

Upload, assessment, and approval passed; publication failed closed on four inferred scopes not included in review. Assessment also showed that runtime-only manifest registration leaves published artifact resources empty, so no static source gate or managed dependency provisioning was reached.
Added a reusable build-time manifest executor and bound x-faster-whisper to generate META-INF/meshingress/tool-manifest.json before JAR packaging; focused tests and JAR inspection passed.

Fresh x-faster-whisper publication lifecycle exported review resources, installed one runtime handler, and materialized the pinned SYSTRAN source under repository/vendor without bundling the tool; server-side Python venv creation remains deferred.
Replaced generated application.yaml with typed application.properties output and updated repository/runtime resource consumers; verification was intentionally not run at user direction.

Added static Python project discovery, server-managed venv provisioning, child-context interpreter injection, and Windows-safe staging identities. Focused provisioning/runtime tests passed; the live activation attempt reached the provider before an unrelated publication-signature barrier prevented a final retry.

Corrected a Windows ProcessBuilder working-directory length failure by shortening the disposable staging path. The production PythonVenvProvisioner then created the managed Faster Whisper venv, installed the staged project, verified import faster_whisper, and passed pip check without modifying the vendor checkout.

Changed the required lifecycle boundary: external source and candidate Python environment resolution must occur during assessment for user review. Activation may only promote or reuse an approved, verified candidate; it must not first download source or install Python dependencies.
